CADASTRE.Title: Cadastre
CADASTRE.GMOnly: Only the GM can create and edit Cadastre maps.

Manager.Title: Cadastre: maps
Manager.Empty: No maps yet. Start with “New map”.
Manager.DeleteConfirm: Delete the map {name}? An already exported scene is left untouched.

Editor.AnimateWater: Animate the water (paused: still water, as in the exported image)
Editor.WindPreview: Animate the wind in the grass (the mouse parts the grass like a token)
Editor.MapPanelHint: Map settings: name, size, wind, water

Hints.select: Click: select, drag: move. Selected wall: drag nodes and handles (Alt: independent handles), double-click a node: corner ↔ curve, double-click the wall: new node. Del: delete, Ctrl+D: duplicate. Selected object: corners to scale, circle to rotate (by 15°, Alt: free).
Hints.brush: Drag to paint the floor freehand. Alt: erases the floor.
Hints.shape: Rectangle, ellipse: drag (Shift: square, circle). Pen: click for a corner, click-drag for a curve, click the first point or Enter to close.
Hints.wall: Pen: click for a corner, click-drag for a curve, Enter or double-click to finish, click the first point to close. Freehand: drag. Ends snap to nearby walls, so a partition properly closes its room.
Hints.door: Click a wall to place a door.
Hints.prop: Click to place. R and Shift+R: rotate by 15°.
Hints.pan: Right click, middle button or Space + click: pan. Wheel: zoom. Esc: cancel the path.
Hints.fill: Click inside a room: lays the floor up to the walls (closed doors included). Outside, fills everything not enclosed.
Hints.path: Road, quay: trace the curve with the pen (click: corner, click-drag: curve, Enter: finish) or freehand. Width, floor and edge in the panel. With selection, drag its points to reshape it. Rivers are traced with the Water tool.
Hints.trees: Click: one tree. Drag: scatters trees within the brush, spaced by density. Every tree is unique; select one afterwards to move, rotate or resize it.
Hints.biome: Pick a biome then “Apply to the whole map”: its ground becomes the map background and its vegetation is sown wherever it can grow (not in water, rooms, paths or on built floors). Small plants stay under the trees. Dragging on the map paints the biome on a single area.
Hints.water: Extent: paint, fill, draw or trace a river (Alt: erase). Depth and type: brush that deepens or raises the bed (Alt: the opposite), or paints a water type. Currents: drag to draw a current in its direction, click a river to set its own.

Panel.NoSelection: Nothing selected. Click a wall, a door or an object.
Panel.Name: Name
Panel.ApplyHint: Anything outside the new size is clipped (Ctrl+Z to go back).
Panel.NoTextures: No imported textures. The button on the right opens the library.
Panel.NoProps: No imported objects. The button on the right opens the library.
Panel.BiomeCurrent: Map biome: {name}. Applying it again re-sows its vegetation (after drawing water, paths or rooms, for example).

WaterExtentNotes.brush: Paint water freehand. Alt: erase water.
WaterExtentNotes.fill: Click: fills the enclosed area with water (walls included).
WaterExtentNotes.shape: Draw a pool: rectangle, ellipse or pen.
WaterExtentNotes.river: Trace a river freehand; it gets a current along the stroke, adjustable in Currents.
WaterExtentNotes.erase: Erases painted water and cuts rivers under the eraser; the rest of the map is untouched.

DepthNotes.deeper: The bed sinks under the brush (Alt: raises). Colour shows depth: light, shallow; dark, deep.
DepthNotes.shallower: The bed rises under the brush (Alt: sinks). Shallow: clearer water, faster current, waves run further up a beach.
DepthNotes.reset: Restores automatic depth: the bed sinks away from the shore.
DepthNotes.type: Paint a water type; “Default” (or Alt) restores the map's type, set in the Map panel. Types blend at their edges.

Panel.CurrentsGenerateHint: Places currents along the channels of all the map's water, from one map exit to another, at the chosen speed. Previously generated currents are replaced; hand-drawn ones stay.
Panel.CurrentsNone: No channel long enough for a current (a round pond stays calm).

CurrentNotes.draw: Drag in the current's direction: the water follows through the whole channel, faster where it narrows, and flows around islands. "Generate currents" places some along the channels. Click a river: its current.
CurrentNotes.calm: Paint an area with no current (Alt: erase it).
CurrentNotes.erase: Erases drawn currents and calm water under the eraser.

Export.Title: Export to scene
Export.Choice: This map already has a scene: {scene}. Updating it replaces its background and the walls placed by Cadastre; tokens, lights and hand-placed walls stay.
Export.Empty: The map is empty: nothing to export.
Export.Reduced: Very large map: the image is reduced to {size} px per side, Foundry stretches it to the scene size.
Export.Missing: Images not found, left blank on the scene: {list}
Export.Tiles: Cadastre: cutting the background into fine tiles ({done} / {total})…

Library.Title: Cadastre: asset library
Library.MenuHint: Outside images (asset packs, your own files) used as objects or floor textures in the editor.
Library.AddFileHint: Add an image already in Foundry's data
Library.AddFolderHint: Import every image of a folder and its subfolders (an asset pack, for instance)
Library.UploadHint: Send images from your computer to the world
Library.Empty: The library is empty. Add a file, a whole folder, or upload images.
Library.Name: Name
Library.DeleteHint: Removes the asset from the library. The file stays in place, and maps using it keep their copy.
Library.PpcHint: 200 for most packs. A size written in the file name (“_2x1”) wins for objects.
Library.Truncated: Very large folder: only the first {n} images were read.

Settings.WindLevelHint: In scenes exported by Cadastre. Per-player setting: lower it on a low-end computer.
Settings.WaterLevelHint: In scenes exported by Cadastre. Per-player setting: lower it on a low-end computer.
Settings.GrassStatsHint: Shows in the top-left what costs: frames per second, browser freezes (whatever module causes them), scene load time, GPU memory, and for trees, grass and water what is drawn and the time per frame.
Settings.GrassRenderHint: “As in 0.1.8”: the grass from before the optimizations (rectangular blades, wind computed for each blade, every blade drawn even from afar). Heavier. Per-player setting; it also applies to the editor (reopen it) and the exported image.
Settings.BackgroundPpcHint: With Vellum active, the background is cut into fine tiles that Vellum loads on demand when zooming: ground, stones and paths stay sharp up close. Finer = longer export and more disk space (a 50 × 40 forest: ≈ 100 MB at 300 px per square). Without Vellum, the usual background is exported.

BackgroundPpcs.300: Very fine (300 px per square, recommended)

Settings.FirefliesHint: Fireflies drifting over marshes, more of them as the sun sets or the scene gets dark. They move away from tokens.
Settings.TreeShadowHint: Strength of the shadows of trees, objects and walls. Applied immediately, no re-export needed.
Settings.SunTimeHint: Time of day in Cadastre scenes, from 5 to 21. Every shadow (trees, objects, walls) turns and stretches live for every player: the sun rises in the east, is south at noon (short shadows towards the top of the map), sets in the west. Macro: game.modules.get("cadastre").api.setSunTime(18).
